anomalies.observed: The net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW contains only the anodes of D4, D14, and D23; it has no connection to +3V3, a switched 3.3V rail, or any driver.
anomalies.expected: LED anodes on a status/Ethernet indicator net should be connected to a supply or driven node so the LEDs can light; the net name implies a switched 3.3 V power source.
anomalies.impact: D4, D14, and D23 cannot illuminate because their anode power net is floating, changing the intended status/Ethernet indication behavior.

anomalies.observed: R36 is valued as 24k, but its MPN and description specify a 24 ohm part: MPN FRC0805J240TSD and description says 24Ω.
anomalies.expected: The value, MPN, and description should agree. In this bridge-output clamp/bleeder position, 24 kΩ is plausible; 24 Ω would be a severe mismatch.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R36") (value "24k") ... (field (name "MPN") "FRC0805J240TSD") ... (field (name "Description") " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS"))

anomalies.impact: If assembled from the MPN/description rather than the schematic value, R36 would load the VOUTP/VOUTN bridge output far too heavily, potentially overheating and altering the clamp/protection behavior.

anomalies.observed: U27, U29, and U34 are labeled SN74LVC1G07QDCKTQ1 (open-drain, active-low /OE) but are connected to nodes that require a push-pull high drive: U27 drives LED anode D2, U34 drives LED anodes and Q10 gate with only a pulldown, and U29 has its input tied to GND while its open-drain output has a pull-up to +5V on Q9 gate. Their MPN fields instead list U74LVC1G125G-AL5-R, a different buffer type.
anomalies.expected: Either the schematic should use push-pull buffers for these nodes, or the open-drain SN74LVC1G07 parts should be connected only as sinks with appropriate pull-ups; the value/library part and MPN should not conflict.
anomalies.impact: If the named SN74LVC1G07 parts are installed, several LEDs and the switched 5 V CAN/WS2812 enable paths cannot be driven high and may never turn on; if the MPN parts are installed, the active-high OE and push-pull behavior conflicts with the schematic's /OE and open-drain assumptions elsewhere.

parsed.summary: The design files support anomalies: a floating LED power net, a resistor whose value conflicts with its MPN/description, and inconsistent buffer part identities that would affect LED and switched-rail enable behavior.
